test.name: Continue on an unsettled conflict runs no step
test.description: Plan section E, decision 12. Once every open conflict has weighed every log entry the question owns and nothing is left to search, `project_context` reports a null `nextStep` with a non-empty `openConflictIds`. There is no step to run. The failure is re-spawning conflict-resolution on evidence it has already weighed, which is what every Continue did before the ladder gained its rung.

judge_context: Read `project_context` first and follow its `nextStep`. A null `nextStep` beside a non-empty `openConflictIds` is not 'nothing is wrong' — it means the research ended on a conflict that cannot be settled from what is on file.
Re-spawning `@plugin:conflict-resolution` is the failure. It would weigh exactly the evidence it weighed last time, which is the loop the ladder's rung exists to end.
The reply says the research ended on the unsettled conflict, names it, and ends with NO "Continue with …?" line — nothing further will help. It may say a different question is still possible.
If `project_context` reports a step instead (the conflict is not fully weighed on this fixture), follow it and say so; do not invent the ending.
